pages.title: A tall ladder · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday morning on a quiet street in Denver. Rafa stands on his porch and looks at a broken light. He does not have a ladder. He looks at the house next door. His neighbor Hal waters the flowers. Rafa walks over with a smile.
“Hi, Hal. Could I borrow your ladder?” says Rafa. “Sure. What do you need it for?” says Hal. “I need to fix a light on my porch.” says Rafa.
